title: A note on the horizontal class transposition group
summary: Let $n$ be an integer with $n > 1$. For every $r$ satisfying the inequalities $0 \leq r 3$, $CT_{(n)}\cong S_N$, where $S_N$ is the symmetric group of degree $N$. Thus, we solve a conjecture proposed by Bardakov and Iskra, which has been included in the kourovka notebook: Unsolved problems in group theory, Novosibirsk, 2026.
